label: title
js: game.hold(true); game.step(1); JSON.stringify({ touch: document.body.classList.contains('touch'), scroll: document.getElementById('title').scrollHeight > innerHeight + 2 })

label: play overlaps
js: (() => { game.start({ level: 'easy', go: true }); game.quiet(); game.put(6, 0); game.step(2); const G = game.G; const r = (el) => el && el.getBoundingClientRect(); const hit = (a, b) => a && b && a.width && b.width && a.left < b.right && b.left < a.right && a.top < b.bottom && b.top < a.bottom; const kit = ['kit-help-btn', 'kit-lang-btn', 'kit-sound-btn'].map((id) => document.getElementById(id)).filter((e) => e && getComputedStyle(e).display !== 'none' && getComputedStyle(e).visibility !== 'hidden'); const ctrls = [...document.querySelectorAll('#touch .dk, #touch .tb, .box, .ibtn, .bud')].filter((e) => e.offsetParent); const [x0, y0] = game.toScreen(-10.8, G.midY + G.freeH / 2 - 0.2, 0); const [x1, y1] = game.toScreen(10.8, G.midY - G.freeH / 2 + 0.2, 0); const area = { left: x0, top: y0, right: x1, bottom: y1, width: x1 - x0, height: y1 - y0 }; const bad = []; for (const k of kit) { for (const c of ctrls) if (hit(r(k), r(c))) bad.push(k.id + ' x ' + (c.className || c.id)); if (hit(r(k), area)) bad.push(k.id + ' x play area'); } const tcs = [...document.querySelectorAll('#touch .dk, #touch .tb')].filter((c) => c.offsetParent); for (const c of tcs) { if (hit(r(c), area)) bad.push((c.dataset.k) + ' x play area'); for (const d of tcs) if (c !== d && hit(r(c), r(d))) bad.push(c.dataset.k + ' x ' + d.dataset.k); } const small = tcs.map((e) => Math.round(Math.min(r(e).width, r(e).height))); const offscreen = tcs.filter((e) => { const b = r(e); return b.left < 0 || b.top < 0 || b.right > innerWidth || b.bottom > innerHeight; }).map((e) => e.dataset.k); return JSON.stringify({ touch: document.body.classList.contains('touch'), area: [Math.round(x0), Math.round(y0), Math.round(x1), Math.round(y1)], pxPerM: +G.k.toFixed(1), floorsShown: +(G.freeH / 3).toFixed(1), bad, offscreen, smallestTap: small.length ? Math.min(...small) : null }); })()

label: results
js: (() => { game.world().phase = 'over'; game.showResults(); game.step(1); return JSON.stringify({ screen: game.state().screen, scroll: document.getElementById('results').scrollHeight > innerHeight + 2 }); })()
